Stone's season chart issued August 30, 2014 at the reduction to 53, over the 53 only; game_depth_chart.json in this folder is the released game input and the two files are changed together. Every player on the 53 holds a chart place; the two reserve/injured players and the eight practice-squad players are not on the chart.

sources: The August 28 personnel packet's season depth chart baseline (Regular-season Week 1.md: Adams X, Thielen H, Hawkins Z; Lewis, Kelce, Jensen; Monroe, Bitonio, Brewster, Turner, Johnson; Kreiter snapping; Hawkins returning kicks and punts with Hurns the second punt returner; Nicks back to X and Adams to Z only after medical clearance and a full practice week); the frozen August 27 Atlanta chart (Preseason_Games/Game_04/depth_chart.json) for every other order; the current roster for control and availability; the August 30 reduction (Roster_Decisions/final_roster_cuts.md) for the 53. Earlier: career/2013/depth_chart.json (Git 781213a, carried order); current career/2013/roster.md; current career/2014/finances/player_contracts/contract_status.md; career/2014/free_agency/signings.md; ledger Entries 79 and 85 through 89; Entry 94 (league year opened); Entry 95 (March 2014 free-agency replay); Entry 108 (2014 draft and undrafted signings); Entry 110 (Rackley traded); Entry 111 (Stone's May 12 starting roles; rookie minicamp and Phase Two closed)
rule: Order within each kernel position group, first = starter, as the kernel reads it. The packet's baseline sets the starting eleven on offense, the snapper and the returners; the Atlanta chart's order is carried for everyone else, minus the players who left on August 30. A player out under a medical instruction is listed last in his group while out (Nicks, Hoskins) and is on the inactive list; a player on reserve/injured is off the chart; his return to the order is Stone's decision on clearance under the packet's condition. The roles field carries the kernel roles (passer, placekicker, punt, kick_return, punt_return); Hurns is the second punt returner by Stone's instruction and is not given the kernel role, which the kernel reads as the first returner. Each change is logged in career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/depth_chart.md.
note: The released game input is career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/game_depth_chart.json (runtime/seasons.py names it as the required 2014 input; runtime/week_inputs.py reads it as Stone's order). This working copy mirrors it with the contract flags, availability notes, the removed-player history and the update log.

game_day_inactives.note: Seven of the 53 are inactive for Week 2 at Washington (46 dress; rules library R4), set by Stone on September 13, 2014 after the Washington preparation. Hakeem Nicks (out, multi-week, projected return September 20, 2014) and Gator Hoskins (out, short, projected return September 16, 2014) are inactive by medical instruction. The other five are set by Stone's standing rule for the healthy inactives: the deepest healthy reserve on the chart in each of the five largest healthy position groups, never below a legal game-day unit, re-set each week; at September 13 those groups are the defensive backs (10: Alan Ball, listed last in the group in his first week after signing September 8), the offensive line (9: Corey Linsley), the defensive line (8: Kasim Edebali), the linebackers (7: Todd Davis) and the receivers (5 healthy: Taylor Gabriel). Maurice Jones-Drew cleared September 12, his projected date, and is active by Stone's decision. Mike Harris and Dwight Lowery are on reserve/injured from September 8 and are not on the chart. The four reserve/injured players and the seven practice-squad players are not on the 53 and cannot appear here.
